title: Receivables & Payables
description: Who owes you and whom you owe — open AR and AP with due-date worklists and the largest customer and supplier balances.
notes: Overdue and aging charts require the CVT_AR_AGING / CVT_AP_AGING views (run scripts/sap_b1_finance_views.sql from the Insights repo against the company database first) — these deduct partial payments. Balances come from the Business Partner master (OCRD); the due-date worklists use document totals.
